info.name: Smithery connect namespaces API
info.description: Connect to MCP servers hosted on Smithery without managing OAuth, credentials, or sessions. Create stateless connections to any MCP server, execute MCP JSON-RPC, list/call tools and triggers, and manage subscriptions for trigger events.

request.description: Create a new namespace owned by the authenticated user or an organization. This endpoint is idempotent - if the namespace already exists and is owned by the user/org, returns success. Pass organizationId in the request body to create an org-owned namespace.

response.name: Bad request (invalid name format or user already has a namespace)

request.description: Delete a namespace owned by the authenticated user. The namespace must not contain any servers. Skills and connections in the namespace will be deleted automatically.

response.name: Forbidden - user does not own this namespace
Conflict - namespace contains servers that must be deleted first

item.name: Create a server under a namespace (deprecated)

request.description: **Deprecated:** Use PUT /servers/{namespace}/{server} instead. Create a new server under the specified namespace. This endpoint is idempotent.

response.name: Forbidden (namespace not owned by user or missing servers:write permission)

item.name: Get user's namespaces or search namespaces

query.description: Text search query (prefix match on name)
Comma-separated list of fields to include in response

request.description: When called without query params, returns the authenticated user's namespaces (backwards compatible). When query params are provided, searches public namespaces with pagination. Use ownerId to filter by owner, hasServers/hasSkills to filter by content, q for text search.
